correctness.rationale: For each method/time the genuinely nested sets and common predictable weights give nonincreasing true risk vector g_r=Gamma_r+tau_r. The nonempty intersection of its confidence box [ell_r,u_r] with g_1>=...>=g_R has coordinate extrema max_{j>=r}ell_j and min_{i<=r}u_i, attained by the minimal and maximal feasible vectors. With tau_1>=...>=tau_R, possible feasibility remains L_r<=0 all r; certified feasibility is min_{i<=r}(U_i+tau_i)<=tau_r. Cartesian method factorization then gives the exact constrained argmin cost threshold; the original simultaneous coverage event implies the new narrower set still covers the oracle at all t, including stopping times. I independently exhaustively compared exact closure with lattice enumeration for 784 two-level and 21,952 three-level rational boxes. The strict two-method example correctly yields A certified after order restriction and A,B retained by rectangle. This is a deterministic consequence of the original time-uniform confidence event, not an independent martingale proof.
